name: Iris

name: Luna
description: Luna is the spark plug and an extremely capable leader of the Guild.

name: Sonia

name: Suzy
description: Suzy is a formidable bounty assassin who is kind at heart. She has a soft spot for orphans and is willing to continue her profession to prevent them from having a similar childhood as hers.

name: Kassie
description: A paranoid, eccentric neuroscientist who walks the line between good and evil. She is obsessed with electroshock therapies and follows her own set of rules.

name: Lila
description: A cool, spry girl from the city of La Luna with excellent parkour skills and a playful nature. She likes to work with Mr. Waggor, outsmarting their foes together with clever pranks and innovative Gloo inventions.

name: Rin
description: Hayato's younger sister, a skilled and calm ninja. As the second child of the Yagami family, she dwells in the shadow to keep her family's flame alive.

name: Primis
description: Nobody knows how he got onto Bermuda, except that he was here before everyone else. Extremely good at adapting to the environment, he is like a chameleon that survives and thrives.

description: Ford is trained at sea and extremely tough.

name: Miguel

description: Joseph is a well-known physicist, but he is also a player.

name: Alok
description: Alok is a world famous DJ, ready to drop a beat.

name: Alvaro
description: Alvaro is a wild but skilled demolitionist.

name: Jota
description: Jota is a parkour expert and stuntman.

name: Luqueta

name: Jai
description: Jai is a decorated SWAT commander.

name: K
description: K is a professor and jiu-jitsu expert.

name: Sverr
description: Sverr is a top-tier MMA fighter.

description: Skyler is a CEO and superstar.

name: Shirou
description: Shirou is the fastest delivery guy around.

name: Andrew "the Fierce"
description: Andrew "the Fierce" is a man on a mission.

name: D-bee
description: D-bee is a music maker and streetdancer.

name: Thiva
description: Thiva is a rising singer-musician star.

name: Dimitri
description: Dimitri is a world renowned sound technology engineer.

name: Leon
description: Leon is a rising star in the basketball scene.

name: Otho
description: Otho is a memory tech engineer at a polytech university.

name: Nairi
description: Nairi is a storm chaser who researches about climate technology.

name: Thala
description: Thala is a man full of motivation despite having grown up under challenging circumstances. He achieved success through sheer hard work and is now determined to help others find their light.

name: Kenta
description: Kenta is Hayato's bodyguard and a skilled weaponsmith.

name: Homer
description: Homer is a blind assassin whose other senses more than make up for his lost one.

name: J.Biebs
description: J.Biebs is a singer who dedicates his life and uses his singing to reunite the world.

name: Tatsuya
description: Tatsuya is a hothead who is willing to trust to make his city a better place.

name: Santino
description: Santino Valentine is a fashion designer, who is always a trending subject in the fashion world and on social media.

name: Orion
description: Orion is a former mercenary who underwent a biological transformation and obtained a formidable power.

name: Alvaro "Rageblast"
description: Alvaro "Firebrand" is a wild but skilled demolitionist.

name: Awakened Alok
description: Awakened Alok illuminates the world with music and color.

name: Ignis
description: Ignis is a superpowered teenager who was born with the ability to "ignite". Although sometimes his power causes even bigger problems, he still steps up to fight crime and uphold justice.

name: Ryden
description: A 16-year-old genius inventor with knowledge beyond his age. Once a little boy who sought refuge under the protection of his sister, Suzy, he now bravely stands on the battlefield with his inventions.

name: Kairos
description: A former soldier of the Special Forces. His fate took a sharp turn when encountering a mysterious energy source, which transformed his body and instilled a constant craving for more energy.

name: Koda
description: Born in the arctic region, Koda was once led by a snow fox to find a mask embedded with advanced tech of his village. The nature-loving boy has longed for an adventure in the outside world. As he met Wolfrahh while playing games online and, later on, Leon and his sister, Koda began to explore what is beyond the familiar.

name: Oscar
description: A brilliant, even slightly overachieving student by day and a beloved vigilante by night. With his flashy physical prowess, Oscar leaps through the shadows to take down the evil.

name: Nero
description: A miraculous survivor of a brutal freeze, who gained the power to shape dreams on his last legs. All-powerful in the dreamspace, he acts solitarily and stays untraceable in the waking world.

name: Morse
description: Silent and free like a mouse, Morse never leaves a trace behind. He slips between the real world and the web, driven only by self-interests.

name: Ray
description: Tired of endless fighting, Ray chose to leave the gang behind with help from Shirou's father. Since then, he has wandered through the hidden corners of different cities, protecting the weak with his own power.

Free Fire Master League Divisi 1
description: Free Fire Master League (FFML)  Divisi 1 is the highest league consisting of 18 professional teams in Indonesia. \n\nThe champions of FFML will represent the Indonesia region as the first seed. They will compete in the FFWS Finals.

name: Free Fire Indonesia Masters
description: Free Fire Indonesia Masters (FFIM) is an open tournament for all Free Fire players in Indonesia.\n\nThe champions of FFIM will represent the Indonesia region as the second seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Brazilian League
description:
Free Fire Brazilian League (LBFF) is Garena's premier Free Fire competition in Brazil. 

The champions of LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire League
description:
Free Fire League Latin America (FFL) is the ultimate Free Fire tournament in Latin America.

The champions of FFL will represent the LATAM region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFL will represent the LATAM region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Pakistan League
description: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: VietNam Free Fire League
description:
Vietnam Free Fire League (VFL) is the highest tier level of Free Fire Esports competition in Viet Nam.

The champions of VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Europe Championship
description: Free Fire Europe Championship (FFEC) is the highest level of Free Fire Esports competition in Europe.\n\nThe champions of FFEC will represent the Europe region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Arab League
description:
Free Fire Arab League (FFAL) is the top league for the Free Fire pro-teams in the Middle East and North Africa .

The champions of FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: MCPS Majors
description:
MCPS Majors is the top league for Malaysia, Cambodia, Philippines, and Sri Lanka region. 

The champions of MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Pakistan League
description: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: Free Fire Cup
description: Free Fire Cup is an open tournament for all players in Taiwan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Cup will represent the Taiwan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

name: FFWS Championship
description: The Play-ins will feature 9 teams battling it out to earn a spot at the Finals. The top 4 teams from the Play-ins will join the 8 top-seeded teams, and form the 12 teams who will compete to be winners of the FFWS 2022 Bangkok.\n\nThe teams will battle over 8 rounds – across 4 maps – to be the last one standing, with points awarded based on round ranking and the number of eliminations.

name: Amaterasu
description: Create a wall of dark flames in the target area. It will destroy Gloo Walls and deal damage to enemies inside. It will also ignore any obstacles.

name: Shikigami Dance
description: Gather and spread out paper pieces to create paper bombs at random locations near enemies in range. The bombs will ignite and explode randomly.

name: Detonating Clay
description: Create and control a large bird. While flying, the bird can be detonated to cause damage to enemies in range if not destroyed. It will automatically explode when duration ends. The user will return to character's position after the bird is detonated or destroyed.

name: Water Style: Shark Bomb
description: (Passive) When not on cooldown, dealing damage to enemies will summon biting sharks that inflict additional damage.

name: Curse Jutsu: Possession
description: Draw a special circle on the ground. While inside it, the user can deflect the damage taken back to the attacker. If downed within the circle, the user will be automatically helped up.

name: Universal Pull
description: Increase Shield Points and create a spherical force field around the user, pulling enemies toward them. While in effect, reveal enemy locations and deal damage over time to in-range Gloo Walls.
